nodes.summary: The linear parent–offspring model on a population described by a probability measure `μ`: the parental (mid-parent) value `parent` and the offspring value `offspring` are integrable, `mean` is the population mean of the parental value, and the offspring value regresses linearly on the parental value, `𝔼[O | P] = mean + h2 * (P - mean)` (equivalently `O = mean + h2 (P - mean) + e` with `𝔼[e | P] = 0`). Here `h2` is…
nodes.title: Linear parent–offspring regression model

nodes.summary: The breeder's equation (Lush 1937): if the selected group `s` is determined by the parental value (an event of `σ(P)`) and has positive mass, the response to selection is the heritability times the selection differential, `R = h² S`.
nodes.title: Breeder's equation

nodes.summary: Selecting the whole population gives no response, `R = 0`.
nodes.title: Selecting the whole population gives zero response

nodes.summary: The response to selection `R = 𝔼[O | selected] - μ`: the mean offspring value of the selected parents, relative to the population mean.
nodes.title: Response to selection

nodes.summary: Selecting the whole population gives no selection differential, `S = 0`.
nodes.title: Selecting the whole population gives zero selection differential

nodes.summary: The selection differential `S = 𝔼[P | selected] - μ` of the selected group `s`.
nodes.title: Selection differential

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
